comment: Chinese 410, Dr. Gao is a great teacher and cares about his students' learning. Daily vocabulary quizzes and weekly group projects made up the majority of the graded material. Lots of writing and presentations.
If you are interested in Chinese culture, Dr. Gao is a good choice for you to take class with. The grade of essays are fair, and the readings are interesting.
There is a quiz nearly every class, and the workload can be tough, but Gao Laoshi does a very good job of actually teaching the content.

Gao Laoshi is a very caring, humorous, and effective professor as he teaches Chinese intensively yet understands how to keep students involved. We engaged in many different forms of self-presentation, acting, and visualizing concepts all in Chinese -- many of this being groupwork. Overall enjoyed this class and made me want to continue in CHIN 301.

I can't stress this enough, take Dr.Gao!  He makes such a complex language so much better, he's also very funny. You will have a lot of quizzes on characters throughout the semester but they're not hard. He cares so much about his students and will do anything to help you succeed. Fun Fact: He loves Taylor swift, she'll be in every slide show lol.

Very understanding and passionate about international/Chinese relations. The hwk can get annoying after a while, but he doesn't grade harshly on it. You can rewrite papers and get full credit back. He occasionally cold-calls so beware. No tests.

Workload: hwk every class (either long article or movie) w pop quiz, one 300 word BB post/week.
